openingPreconditions: The exact candidate and its configuration have been frozen and recorded before case content is opened.
The acceptance criteria have been frozen and their hash verified before case content is opened.
A later explicit decision selects this holdout and authorizes opening; creation and sealing alone do not grant permission.
usageBoundary: Do not expose case prompts, executor materials or acceptance criteria to candidate authors before opening is authorized.
Do not execute enhancement, downstream generation or paid evaluation while openingAuthorized or evaluationAuthorized is false.
Retain the original cases and criteria; later changes require a separately identified version and new hashes.
